headline: MOIL Limited Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: MOIL Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control event requiring mandatory regulatory notification.
detail: MOIL Limited, a Manganese Ore Producing Company listed on NSE and BSE and a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Steel, has submitted a formal disclosure to the exchange under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is a mandatory filing when a party acquires or proposes to acquire shares or voting rights that cross specified thresholds. The disclosure does not by itself confirm a takeover bid; it indicates that shareholding changes have occurred or are contemplated and must be transparently reported to the market.
